header.name: Calculate OEE
header.description: This flow will calculate OEE for every workcenter per hour per shift. every 10 minutes or anytime a new production history record or workcenter history is created.

data.query:
query (
  $startTime: DateTime!,
  $endTime: DateTime!
) {

  productionHistory(where: {
    _and:[
    	{occurAt:{_gte: $startTime}}
    	{occurAt:{ _lt: $endTime}}	
  	]
    
  }) {
    total
    edges {
      node {
        id
        idealRate
        quantity
        standardRate
        includeInProductionCounts
        employeeName
        externalId
        heatCode
        heatNo
        lotNo
        masterUnitNo
        operationCode
        operationNumber
        productNumber
        productNumberRevision
        productRevision
        scrapReasonExt
        serialNo
        trackingNo
        unit
        
        workOrderNumber
        creditedAt
        occurAt
        customData
        externalResponse
        shiftId
        transactionTypeId
        approvedWorkcenterId
        productionRunId
        productionRun{
          id
          idealAggregate
          standardAggregate
          startAt
          endAt
        }
        scrapReasonId
        workcenterId
      }
    }
  }

}
